# Customer Feedback Portal

## Purpose
Collect customer feedback, validate submissions, and provide an administrative review dashboard.

## Technology and source layout
Next.js, TypeScript, and Playwright. Follow framework-native source conventions.

## Modules and constraints
Document modules, integrations, and acceptance expectations here.

taxonomy:
# Project Taxonomy

- Version: 1.0
- Previous version: none

## Documentation

All AI Factory artifacts live under .ai_factory/.
Use .ai_factory/docs/project-brief.md for evolving purpose, scope, technology, integrations and source layout.
Use .ai_factory/docs/architecture/, .ai_factory/docs/requirements/, .ai_factory/docs/design/, .ai_factory/docs/decisions/, .ai_factory/docs/security/, and .ai_factory/docs/operations/ as appropriate.
For large projects use requirements/modules/<module>/ and design/modules/<module>/; put cross-cutting work under shared/.

## Delivery

Use .ai_factory/delivery/intakes/, .ai_factory/delivery/planning/, .ai_factory/delivery/processes/, .ai_factory/delivery/agents/, .ai_factory/delivery/actions/, .ai_factory/delivery/runs/, .ai_factory/delivery/reviews/, and .ai_factory/delivery/releases/.
Run-specific evidence belongs under .ai_factory/delivery/runs/<run-id>/; iteration and task identifiers must remain traceable.
PostgreSQL owns live execution state. Files under .ai_factory/delivery/runs/ are reviewable exports, not recovery checkpoints.

## Tests and source

Use .ai_factory/tests/functional/ for Playwright browser tests by default, and .ai_factory/tests/reports/ for evidence.
Use .ai_factory/tests/unit/, .ai_factory/tests/integration/, and .ai_factory/tests/fixtures/ where the technology allows it.
Native conventions take precedence for source and co-located tests (for example src/test/ in Java).
Add or update tests during feature and defect-remediation iterations. Keep module identifiers consistent across requirements, design and tests.

## Versioning

Increment the human-readable version for changes. Use a minor increment for compatible additions and a major increment for restructuring.
Process runs keep an immutable copy of the taxonomy version used at their start.

processYaml:
schemaVersion: 1
id: feature-delivery
version: "0.1"
name: Feature delivery
stages:
  - id: readiness
    name: Solution Architect readiness review
    mode: sequential
    steps:
      - id: review-readiness
        agent: solution-architect
        action: review-intake-readiness
        instructions: Review the whole intake end to end, including the iteration plan
          when present. Check requirements, technical decisions, dependencies
          and prerequisites. Identify technical blockers early and return
          blocked when human clarification is needed.
        access: read
        when: always
        config: {}
  - id: planning
    name: Plan iteration stories
    mode: sequential
    steps:
      - id: plan
        agent: scrum-master
        action: plan-stories
        instructions: Plan user stories for the current delivery iteration only (or the
          narrow intake for single-iteration delivery). Return an ordered
          workItems array of 1 to 20 unique ids, titles and descriptions with
          acceptance criteria. Record dependencies and keep every story within
          the iteration objectives.
        access: write
        when: always
        config: {}
  - id: analysis
    name: Elaborate stories and design tests
    mode: parallel
    steps:
      - id: stories
        agent: business-analyst
        action: analyze
        instructions: Elaborate every planned story in this iteration with requirements,
          acceptance criteria and edge cases. Preserve planned story ids. Own
          requirement artifacts; do not edit test-design artifacts.
        access: write
        when: always
        config: {}
      - id: test-design
        agent: test-architect
        action: design-tests
        instructions: Create traceable test cases for all planned stories in this
          iteration, including failure cases. Own test-design artifacts; do not
          edit requirement artifacts. Work from the shared story plan.
        access: write
        when: always
        config: {}
  - id: scope-review
    name: Review iteration readiness
    mode: sequential
    steps:
      - id: scope
        agent: technical-architect
        action: review-iteration-scope
        instructions: Review all current iteration stories, elaborated requirements and
          test cases for consistency, feasibility and technical readiness. Bound
          this review to current iteration objectives. Missing prerequisites or
          technical blockers must be reported as blocked.
        access: read
        when: always
        config: {}
  - id: delivery
    name: Develop and test complete iteration
    mode: iteration
    steps:
      - id: build
        agent: full-stack-developer
        action: implement
        instructions: Implement every planned story in the current delivery iteration.
          Follow the elaborated requirements, acceptance criteria and test
          design. On remediation attempts fix the reported iteration test
          defects and update regression tests.
        access: write
        when: always
        config: {}
      - id: test
        agent: tester
        action: test
        instructions: After the developer completes all planned stories, execute
          integrated, regression and acceptance tests for the complete
          iteration. Report defects with evidence; never claim unexecuted tests
          passed. Success requires every iteration objective to pass.
        access: write
        when: always
        config: {}
    exitWhen: testing.accepted
    requiresPlan: plan-stories
  - id: iteration-review
    name: Technical Architect final iteration delivery review
    mode: sequential
    steps:
      - id: review-delivery
        agent: technical-architect
        action: review-iteration-delivery
        instructions: After the complete iteration passes testing, review the delivery
          end to end, including all stories, cross-story architecture,
          integration and test evidence. Report blockers for human review.
          Approve only when the iteration objectives are satisfied.
        access: read
        when: always
        config: {}
  - id: solution-review
    name: Review overall intake solution
    mode: sequential
    steps:
      - id: review-solution
        agent: solution-architect
        action: review-intake-solution
        instructions: Review the completed intake end to end across all delivery
          iterations. Check requirements coverage, architecture, integration and
          test evidence. Report unresolved issues as defects or blocked.
        access: read
        when: always
        config: {}
  - id: closure
    name: Technical Project Manager intake closure
    mode: sequential
    steps:
      - id: close
        agent: technical-project-manager
        action: close-intake
        instructions: Close the intake only after the Solution Architect review passes.
          Record delivered scope, story and iteration outcomes, test and review
          evidence, decisions and any explicitly accepted limitations. Do not
          deploy or publish.
        access: write
        when: always
        config: {}
